sentences.text:
2. This writ petition is filed by the wife of detenu- Pradeep Sarkar @ Sanjay Pradeep Sarkar @
Prasad @ Pradeep Tagore challenging the order of detention dated 27.11.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders,
Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders,
Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders,
Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Amendment Act No.13 of 2018), detaining the detenu on the ground that he was involved in Cr.No.719 of 2021 registered under Section 370 (A) (2) of Indian Penal Code and Sections 3, 4 and 5 of the Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956 in Kushaiguda Police Station.

3. Heard Smt B.Mohana Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Home representing learned Advocate General appearing for the respondents.
4.
The order of detention refers to a solitary crime registered on 30.09.2021.
However, the detention order also refers to the crime registered in the year 2018 alleging similar offences.
It appears, in pursuant to the crime registered on 05.07.2018, the detenu was detained vide order of detention dated 20.09.2018.
The said detention order was set aside by this Court in W.P.No.33705 of 2018.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the order of detention reads as if the detenu is indulging in similar crimes continuously since the year 2018, whereas, he was involved in one crime in the year 2018 and this is the second crime.
She would submit that this also shows total non-application of mind in dealing with the issue of preventively detaining a person offending his right to life and liberty.
Learned counsel further submits that on 26.11.2021 the criminal Court granted bail by imposing certain conditions.

The first condition is that the accused should execute personal bond for Rs.10,000/- with two sureties each and the second condition that he should not leave Hyderabad city, without prior permission of the jurisdictional Magistrate.
She therefore submits that the conditions imposed in the bail order sufficiently safeguard the interest of the prosecution.
According to learned counsel, the facts of the case do not warrant resorting to extreme measure of preventive detention.

By referring to various decisions, she submits that considering the past record is also erroneous and vitiates the order of detention on that ground 6. Having satisfied with the prima-facie issue of detaining the detenu by referring to solitary crime registered in the year 2018 we are not going into the other contentions urged by learned counsel for the petitioner.
7. Suffice to note that though, the detenu was detained earlier on account of involvement in similar crime, but the said order of detention was set aside.

Though the allegations levelled in the said Seema Sarkar vs The State Of Telangana on 10 March, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139408784/
2 incident is similar to the allegations levelled in this case, but the detenu alleged to have been not involved in similar crime for the last three years before resorting to the present detention order.

sentences.text: It is also not the case of the respondents that detenu was involved in similar crimes and that it has come to their knowledge that the detenu was involved in similar crimes.
8. In the peculiar facts of this case, we are inclined to allow the writ petition by setting aside the order of detention.
9. In the result, the Writ Petition is allowed.

The impugned detention order passed by the Office of t h e C o m m i s s i o n e r o f P o l i c e , R a c h a k o n d a - 2 n d r e s p o n d e n t v i d e No.147/PD-CELL/CCRB/RCKD/2021 dated 27.11.2021 and the consequential confirmation order of the Principal Secretary to Government, General Administration Department, Hyderabad-1st respondent confirming the detention vide G.O.Rt.No.350, General Administration (SPL.(Law &
Order) Department dated 11.02.2022, are hereby set aside.

The respondents are directed to set the detenu, namely Pradeep Sarkar @ Sanjay Pradeep Sarkar @ Prasad @ Pradeep Tagore S/o.Nagen Sarkar, Age : 45 yrs, R/o.Flat No.303, II Floor, Mallareddynagar Colony, Venture II, Lothukunta,
Alwal, N/o.Kalna (V & P), Bardhoman District, West Bengal State at liberty forthwith, if he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
